data.situation:
Once the doorway was clear, Lin found room for a magazine and a postcard on the shelf. The magazine's layout placed an old photograph beside a plan of the building. Long before the rooms became flats, Park Road had been a private residence. A caption showed the servants who had cooked and cleaned for the family. Lin read their names rather than treating them as part of the furniture. Dear Lin,
Your grandparents travelled for years before they settled on a small farm. They wanted somewhere to stay for good. Your own decision can be different. A home near work matters to your household now.
I took a domestic flight to visit them last month. Next time I hope to see your new flat.
Love, Aunt Jo Maya: Have you settled on a date for the housewarming?
Lin: Saturday, after the last box is put away.
Maya: Good. The children can play their song. It won't be an immaculate performance; they're still learning the final part.
Lin: That's all right. We'll enjoy it together. Residents' noticeboard
The part-time caretaker post is vacant. Contact the building office for details.
Please keep the entrance clear at peak times, when several residents leave for work.
Saturday: a small welcome gathering on the shared patio. Please check with your neighbours before using the space.

readingBlocks.en: Once the doorway was clear, Lin found room for a magazine and a postcard on the shelf. The magazine's layout placed an old photograph beside a plan of the building. Long before the rooms became flats, Park Road had been a private residence. A caption showed the servants who had cooked and cleaned for the family. Lin read their names rather than treating them as part of the furniture.
readingBlocks.zh: 门口清空后，林在书架上为一份杂志和一张明信片腾出位置。杂志的版式把一张旧照片放在楼房平面图旁。房间改为公寓之前，帕克路这栋房屋曾是一处私人住宅。图注介绍了曾替这个家庭做饭、打扫的家务佣人。林读了他们的名字，没有把他们当作屋里家具的一部分。

readingBlocks.en:
Dear Lin,
Your grandparents travelled for years before they settled on a small farm. They wanted somewhere to stay for good. Your own decision can be different. A home near work matters to your household now.
I took a domestic flight to visit them last month. Next time I hope to see your new flat.
Love, Aunt Jo
readingBlocks.zh:
亲爱的林：
你祖父母旅行多年后，在一座小农场定居。他们想找一个能长久住下去的地方。你的决定可以不同。现在，对你的家庭来说，工作地点附近的住处很重要。
上个月我坐国内航班去看他们。下次希望能看看你的新公寓。
爱你的乔阿姨
readingBlocks.title: From Aunt Jo

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: Have you settled on a date for the housewarming?
Lin: Saturday, after the last box is put away.
Maya: Good. The children can play their song. It won't be an immaculate performance; they're still learning the final part.
Lin: That's all right. We'll enjoy it together.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：乔迁聚会的日期选定了吗？
林：周六，把最后一个箱子收好后。
玛雅：好。孩子们可以演奏那首歌。不会是完美无误的表演，他们还在学最后一部分。
林：没关系。大家一起听就好。

readingBlocks.en:
Residents' noticeboard
The part-time caretaker post is vacant. Contact the building office for details.
Please keep the entrance clear at peak times, when several residents leave for work.
Saturday: a small welcome gathering on the shared patio. Please check with your neighbours before using the space.
readingBlocks.zh:
住户告示板
兼职楼房管理员职位空缺。详情请联系楼房办公室。
高峰时段，多位住户同时出门上班，请保持入口畅通。
周六：共用露台有一场小型欢迎聚会。使用共用空间前，请先与邻居确认。

glossary.note: domestic flight在同一国家境内；与厨房的domestic appliances分开。

externalEvidence.findingZh: 本句为国内航班，即在同一国家境内的航班；不硬套WordNet国家内部事务义。

glossary.zh: 高峰时段；最繁忙的时段
glossary.note: 整块复数名词短语，常与at连用；具体钟点因场所而异，不把时间写成普遍规则。
glossary.example: Several residents leave for work at peak times.
glossary.exampleZh: 高峰时段有多位住户出门上班。

externalEvidence.findingZh: peak可在名词前表示活动或使用人数最多的时段。

glossary.note: settle on + 选定的事项，如settle on a date、settle on Saturday。
glossary.example: They settled on Saturday for the gathering.
glossary.exampleZh: 他们把聚会日期定在了周六。

externalEvidence.findingZh: 从备选项中作出选择或决定。

glossary.zh: 布局；各部分的安排方式
glossary.note: 这里是房间的空间安排；印刷页面的layout也指各部分安排，另在书架的杂志中复用。
glossary.example: The magazine's layout puts the photograph beside the plan.
glossary.exampleZh: 杂志的版式把照片放在平面图旁。

glossary.zh: 共同生活的一组人；家庭
glossary.note: 本课名词，是一起生活并承担费用的人，不是建筑物，也不是household appliances里的定语用法。
glossary.example: A home near work matters to the household.
glossary.exampleZh: 工作地点附近的住处对这个家庭很重要。

glossary.note: 来源R00071是名词租赁安排。rental agreement整块里rental修饰agreement，另有搭配依据；不把两种语法位置都说成来源给出的独立形容词。
glossary.example: Lin checks the full cost before deciding on the rental.
glossary.exampleZh: 林决定租赁安排前核实完整费用。
